description: Unique tank identifier: U01-U04 (Ulva diet), W01-W04 (wakame diet) and C01-C04 (control diet)
The diet provided to abalone within experimental tank. Diets included a control (C01-C04) and experimental diets containing either 20% Ulva (U01-U04) or 20% wakame (W01-W04)

Decimal degrees WGS84 (-180 to +180)

End biomass for each tank

End number of abalone within parent tank, from the drone (zonal statistics) count (all detections)

Mean average abalone length at the beginning of the trial. Aggregated by tank
Mortality across the experimental period expressed as a percentage of start count

Cumulative feed consumed per animal over the trial, in milligrams. Calculated for each tank by dividing the daily feed ration (kg) by the number of live abalone in the tank that day, then summing values across all 131 days of the trial. Calculations in per_feed_capita.xlsx
Length of detected abalone. Measurements are derived from geometry from geospatial coordinates of detected polygons (abalone)
Width of detected abalone. Measurements are derived from geometry from geospatial coordinates of detected polygons (abalone)
Abalone area in mm2 calculated using area = number of pixels in the detected object x (global sampling distance)2
Abalone weight. Derived from length using a pre-established weight-length relationship W =0.000102572*L^3.05321
Condition factor of abalone calculated using Condition factor = 5575 × (weight [g] / length [mm]^2.99) (Britz and Hecht, 1997)
Calendar date of each daily feed and tank-count record, covering the 131-day trial period (10/11/2025 to 20/03/2026)
Daily feed ration delivered per tank, applied uniformly across all monitored tanks on that date
Estimated number of live abalone in tank X on the given date, interpolated between recorded mortality checks. Used as the daily divisor for X
Feed delivered per live abalone in tank X on the given date, calculated as (feed_per_tank_kg x 1,000,000) / X01_count. Summed across all 131 days to give the cumulative per_capita_feed value.
